profile.description: Based on the MIT-licensed and open-weights model DeepSeek-V4-Pro and extended with file processing capabilities. This multimodal bot accepts PDF, TXT, HTML, DOCX and PY files. Previous version: https://poe.com/DeepSeek-V3.2-OSL This bot can't process HEIC, RTF files, PNG, JPG, ODS, WEBM, MP4 and MP3 audios. Maximum file size is 50 MB. Context window: 1M tokens
